payload.test_method: After software PCI reset and driver-rebind attempts did not restore the docked input devices, the dock cable was disconnected from the host long enough to cold-start the dock and then reconnected.
payload.expected_result: The dock controller restarts and the external keyboard and mouse enumerate again.
payload.actual_result: The dock cold-started and the external input devices re-enumerated after cable disconnection and reconnection.
payload.limitations: This is one private journal import from one account, one host, and one recovery attempt. It establishes a recovery for the observed occurrence, not prevention, recurrence rate, or applicability to other dock topologies. Unique hardware and bus identifiers are deliberately omitted.
payload.provenance: Imported from the user's private system-change journal; no raw kernel logs, bus addresses, or unique device identities are attached.
payload.adverse_effects: Dock-attached devices are unavailable during the cable power cycle. The journal records no additional adverse effect from the successful recovery.

activation.details: This is a one-time physical recovery procedure and makes no persistent configuration change.

root_cause.rationale: The journal observed a fatal dock USB-controller state after the unexpected suspend and successful recovery after cold-starting the dock, but it did not establish why the controller entered that state.
